items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Because his idol was, what's that man, Gate Mouth. Oh, Gate, sure. Gate Mouth was his idol, see.

ctx.x: Was Mr. Schiffman very particular about the bands and how they were formed? Your parents. Your parents had to be?

Because Slim, if you didn't have any uniform, he'd send you downtown. The man, the tailor shop, he'd send you down there and you'd go get the uniform. You'd even have to get rent them or whatever. Because Slim wanted to do a, I forget the name, Morning, some kind of song that he sang. And he wanted to come out there with his coveralls on. He did it one time, but Schiffman didn't want to let him do it no more. He said, no, you come here, you dress up. You put on some kind of suit. And he wore some fabulous things.…
Well, it's also probably cheaper in that you had one band and three artists in those days. You always, which...
